findings: Main messages use protobuf length-delimited framing, confirmed in pinned firmware pb_encode_ex/pb_decode_ex calls.
Main command_id is field 1; command_status is field 2; has_next is field 3.
Identity and power responses are streamed key/value pairs; the final pair sets has_next false.
AXP service UUIDs, readiness marker and wire framing are unrelated to this vendor protocol.
